title: GoogleAPIOptions
description: Native Google Gen AI GenerateContent arguments and configuration used by Captain's API runtime.

model.title: Model
model.description: Google model identifier passed to GenerateContent.

contents.title: Contents
contents.description: Conversation parts, user input, attachments, and tool results sent to the model.

systemInstruction.title: System instruction
systemInstruction.description: System instruction content supplied separately from the conversation.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature used for response generation.

maxOutputTokens.title: Maximum output tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens generated in the response.

thinkingConfig.title: Thinking configuration
thinkingConfig.description: Thinking budget and inclusion settings for reasoning-capable Gemini models.

responseMimeType.title: Response MIME type
responseMimeType.description: MIME type requested for structured or plain-text output.

responseSchema.title: Response schema
responseSchema.description: Google schema constraining a structured response.

candidateCount.title: Candidate count
candidateCount.description: Number of candidate responses requested from the model.

x-captain-option.note: Captain requests exactly one candidate so each execution has one canonical response.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Native Google tool declarations derived from Captain caller tools.

x-captain-option.note: Captain converts runtime Config.Tools into provider-native function declarations.

toolConfig.title: Tool configuration
toolConfig.description: Native policy controlling Google function-calling behavior.

x-captain-option.note: Captain derives the function-calling policy from its tool loop.

stream.title: Stream
stream.description: Whether GenerateContent returns a stream of response chunks.

x-captain-option.note: Captain selects the streaming generation method for ExecuteStream.

httpOptions.title: HTTP options
httpOptions.description: Per-request HTTP transport and API version settings.

x-captain-option.note: Captain configures the SDK client rather than exposing per-request transport overrides.

topP.title: Top P
topP.description: Cumulative probability mass retained during nucleus sampling.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no native top-p Spec field.

topK.title: Top K
topK.description: Number of highest-probability tokens retained during sampling.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no native top-k Spec field.

stopSequences.title: Stop sequences
stopSequences.description: Text sequences that stop generation when encountered.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no stop-sequence Spec field.

responseLogprobs.title: Response log probabilities
responseLogprobs.description: Whether token log probabilities are included in the response.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not request token log probabilities.

logprobs.title: Log probabilities
logprobs.description: Number of top token log probabilities returned per decoding step.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Google log-probability controls.

presencePenalty.title: Presence penalty
presencePenalty.description: Penalty applied when a token has appeared in the generated text.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no native presence-penalty Spec field.

frequencyPenalty.title: Frequency penalty
frequencyPenalty.description: Penalty scaled by how often a token has appeared in generated text.

x-captain-option.note: Captain has no native frequency-penalty Spec field.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Fixed sampling seed used for best-effort deterministic generation.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose a generation seed.

responseJsonSchema.title: Response JSON Schema
responseJsonSchema.description: Raw JSON Schema constraining generated JSON output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's Genkit adapter converts structured output through responseSchema.

routingConfig.title: Routing configuration
routingConfig.description: Model routing behavior for supported Google endpoints.

x-captain-option.note: Captain resolves one concrete model before calling the provider.

modelSelectionConfig.title: Model selection configuration
modelSelectionConfig.description: Constraints used by automatic model selection.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's registry selects a concrete model before execution.

safetySettings.title: Safety settings
safetySettings.description: Per-category content safety thresholds applied to the request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose per-request Google safety thresholds.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: String key-value labels attached to the request for billing and reporting.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not forward per-request Google labels.

cachedContent.title: Cached content
cachedContent.description: Resource name of previously cached content included in the request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not reference provider-managed cached content.

responseModalities.title: Response modalities
responseModalities.description: Requested output modalities such as text, image, or audio.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's API runtime currently consumes text and tool response parts.

mediaResolution.title: Media resolution
mediaResolution.description: Resolution requested when the model processes media inputs.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose media-resolution selection.

speechConfig.title: Speech configuration
speechConfig.description: Voice and language settings used for generated speech.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's API runtime does not request speech output.

audioTimestamp.title: Audio timestamp
audioTimestamp.description: Whether timestamps are requested for audio input or output.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose Google audio timestamps.

imageConfig.title: Image configuration
imageConfig.description: Generation options for image response modalities.

x-captain-option.note: Captain's API runtime does not request generated images.

enableEnhancedCivicAnswers.title: Enhanced civic answers
enableEnhancedCivicAnswers.description: Whether enhanced civic-information answers are enabled.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose this Google search behavior.

modelArmorConfig.title: Model Armor configuration
modelArmorConfig.description: Model Armor template and filtering behavior applied to the request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not expose per-request Model Armor configuration.

serviceTier.title: Service tier
serviceTier.description: Google processing tier used for the request.

x-captain-option.note: Captain does not select a Google service tier.
